We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Business Development Manager (Industrial Sector) Job at Ascentech Services Limited




        
    

        
        Ascentech Services Limited is the most sought-after Human Resource Solution Provider with its Head Office in Lagos, Nigeria. We have a reputation for satisfying and surpassing clients' expectations through our core offerings: recruitment and Selection, Outsourcing, Training and Development. To accomplish these we leverage creating and managing change in organizations by improving efficiency through our proven and dynamic HR solutions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Business Development Manager (Industrial Sector)
     

            
    



Job Location: Isolo, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: A renowned global leader in the production and supply of premium chemical products.

Job Summary


	We are seeking a results-driven Business Development Manager to drive sales growth and market expansion within the industrial sector.


Key Responsibilities


	Identify and develop new business opportunities.
	Build and maintain strong client relationships.
	Drive sales growth and achieve revenue targets.
	Conduct market research and prepare commercial proposals.
	Collaborate with internal teams to deliver tailored client solutions.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Industrial Chemistry, or any related Pure Engineering discipline.
	5–8 years of business development or sales experience in the chemical or industrial manufacturing sector.
	Strong B2B sales, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
	Proven track record of meeting sales targets.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to: [email protected] using "Business Development Manager (Industrial Sector)" as the subject of the email.

Note: Candidates must have a Chemistry or Pure Engineering educational background.

  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Operations Manager",
  "description": "Ascentech Services Limited is the most sought-after Human Resource Solution Provider with its Head Office in Lagos, Nigeria. We have a reputation for satisfying and surpassing clients&#39; expectations through our core offerings:&nbsp;recruitment and Selection, Outsourcing, Training and Development. To accomplish these we leverage creating and managing change in organizations by improving efficiency through our proven and dynamic HR solutions.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Operations Manager

Job Location: Shomolu. Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	We are recruiting an Operations Manager for a growing company specializing in professional printing technology &mdash; including CTP (Computer-to-Plate) systems, flexographic and litho platesetters, large format printers, plate processors, and prepress workflow/RIP software, alongside quality control instruments like densitometers and spectrophotometers.
	Beyond equipment supply, the business runs a full service arm covering installation, maintenance, annual maintenance contracts, consultancy, and technical training for clients. This role is central to keeping that full sales-to-service pipeline running smoothly.


Key Responsibilities


	Oversee day-to-day operations across sales support, installation/maintenance scheduling, and client service delivery.
	Coordinate technical teams to ensure timely equipment installation, servicing, and AMC fulfillment.
	Manage inventory, vendor relationships, and logistics for equipment and consumables.
	Support process efficiency across departments, ensuring quality and turnaround standards are consistently met.
	Track performance metrics and report on operational KPIs to leadership.


Requirements


	4-5 years of experience in an operations/business management role within the printing prepress or equipment industry.
	Deep hands-on/technical knowledge of CTP systems, flexo and litho platesetters, plate processors, large format printers, and prepress workflow/RIP software &mdash; able to understand technical specifications, troubleshoot at a management level, and speak credibly with engineers and clients on equipment performance.
	Strong organizational and people-management skills, able to coordinate across sales, technical, and support functions.
	Based in or able to commute reliably to Shomolu, Lagos.


Salary
N350,000 Monthly.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to: cv@ascentech.com.ng using &quot;OPERATION MANAGER 17&quot; as the subject of the email.",

Operations Manager Job at Ascentech Services Limited




        
    

        
        Ascentech Services Limited is the most sought-after Human Resource Solution Provider with its Head Office in Lagos, Nigeria. We have a reputation for satisfying and surpassing clients' expectations through our core offerings: recruitment and Selection, Outsourcing, Training and Development. To accomplish these we leverage creating and managing change in organizations by improving efficiency through our proven and dynamic HR solutions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Operations Manager

Job Location: Shomolu. Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role
     

            
    




	We are recruiting an Operations Manager for a growing company specializing in professional printing technology — including CTP (Computer-to-Plate) systems, flexographic and litho platesetters, large format printers, plate processors, and prepress workflow/RIP software, alongside quality control instruments like densitometers and spectrophotometers.
	Beyond equipment supply, the business runs a full service arm covering installation, maintenance, annual maintenance contracts, consultancy, and technical training for clients. This role is central to keeping that full sales-to-service pipeline running smoothly.


Key Responsibilities


	Oversee day-to-day operations across sales support, installation/maintenance scheduling, and client service delivery.
	Coordinate technical teams to ensure timely equipment installation, servicing, and AMC fulfillment.
	Manage inventory, vendor relationships, and logistics for equipment and consumables.
	Support process efficiency across departments, ensuring quality and turnaround standards are consistently met.
	Track performance metrics and report on operational KPIs to leadership.


Requirements


	4-5 years of experience in an operations/business management role within the printing prepress or equipment industry.
	Deep hands-on/technical knowledge of CTP systems, flexo and litho platesetters, plate processors, large format printers, and prepress workflow/RIP software — able to understand technical specifications, troubleshoot at a management level, and speak credibly with engineers and clients on equipment performance.
	Strong organizational and people-management skills, able to coordinate across sales, technical, and support functions.
	Based in or able to commute reliably to Shomolu, Lagos.


Salary
N350,000 Monthly.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to: [email protected] using "OPERATION MANAGER 17" as the subject of the email.
